Summary of websites shared in #general:

• www.informations.com — Shares the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, renowned for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a welcoming, rustic atmosphere, and large windows offer stunning panoramic views of the city skyline. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make every visit feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! Thanks for sharing your personal website (www.dora-website.com). I took a look and think it's a nice, clean introduction to you and your personal corner of the web. A couple of thoughts that might make it even stronger: adding a short bio or a few personal interests would give visitors a better sense of who you are and what you're passionate about, and including some of your work, projects, or photos would make the site feel more engaging and memorable. Overall it's a solid starting point — a bit more content and personality would really bring it to life. Best of luck with it!

Hi Eve! Thanks for sharing your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I enjoyed reading it — it's a lovely introduction to you and your love of hiking. A couple of suggestions to make it even better: adding some photos or descriptions from your hikes would bring the blog to life, and sharing a few recent posts or trail recommendations would give readers something to come back for. Overall it's a warm, approachable blog with a clear personal touch — keep it up! Best of luck with it!
